name: SkyNet Online Shipping for WooCommerce
author: skynetza

sections.description:
SkyNet Online Shipping for WooCommerce integrates your store with SkyNet’s REST API. It calculates real-time shipping rates for Domestic Road, Air, Counter (PUDO), and Export services, automatically creates waybills, and provides tracking integration.

External services

This plugin relies on the following 3rd-party external services to provide its core shipping, quoting, booking, and visual functionality:

  1. SkyPoint / SkyNet Online API (https://skypoint.online / https://uat.skypoint.online)

    • What it is and what it is used for: The SkyNet Online REST API provides courier rate quoting, order booking, waybill/label PDF generation, PUDO collection point locations, tracking status synchronization, address validation, and international customs invoice submission.
    • What data is sent and when:
      • Origin and destination addresses, package weights, dimensions, and parcel values are sent to calculate live shipping rates when a customer checks out or updates their cart.
      • Recipient contact details (name, email, phone, shipping address) and order line items are sent when a shop manager books a shipment or generates a waybill from the WooCommerce order admin screen.
      • Store credentials (API key / customer account number) are sent in request headers for API authentication.
    • Terms and Privacy Policy:
      • SkyNet Terms and Conditions
      • SkyNet Privacy Policy

  2. FlagCDN (https://flagcdn.com)

    • What it is and what it is used for: FlagCDN is a free content delivery network providing country flag icon images. It is used in the WooCommerce admin order export/customs modal to display country flag visual indicators for international destination selection.
    • What data is sent and when: The store manager’s browser makes a standard HTTP GET request containing the ISO 2-letter country code in the image URL when opening the international shipping details modal. No personal, order, or customer data is transmitted.
    • Terms and Privacy Policy:
      • FlagCDN Terms and Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/skynet-online-shipping-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Settings -> Shipping -> SkyNet Online Shipping to configure your API credentials and shipping preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SkyNet account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need active API credentials from SkyNet Online to calculate rates and generate waybills.

Does this plugin support international shipping?

Yes, it supports domestic services within South Africa as well as international export services with automated customs invoice submission.
